key_themes: Cisco mega-earnings: AI infrastructure orders raised to $9B, stock surges most since 2002
US-China trade summit: Trump-Xi Beijing meeting yields Boeing jet order, market-wide optimism
AI spending bifurcation: creates earnings winners (Cisco) and margin losers (Doximity -25%)
Strong Q1/Q2 earnings beats across consumer and travel sectors (YETI, StubHub, Viking)
S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record closes; Dow retakes 50,000

stocks.reason: Q3 FY2026 beat-and-raise: revenue $15.84B vs $15.56B est, EPS $1.06 vs $1.04 est; raised AI infrastructure orders target to $9B from $5B; product orders +35%, networking +50%; stock surged ~17-20%, biggest gain since 2002; six Wall Street firms hiked price targets; announced ~4,000 layoffs for AI reorg

Q4 FY2026 earnings miss: adjusted EPS $0.26 vs $0.28 est; full-year revenue outlook $664-676M below FY2026 level at midpoint; rising AI investment costs pressuring margins; pharma digital ad market soft; stock plunged ~25% to lowest since 2021 IPO; Jefferies downgraded to Hold, slashed PT from $51 to $19
Q1 2026 earnings beat: revenue $446M vs $432M expected, adjusted EBITDA $72.1M vs $65.1M expected; stock surged ~14% on strong live-events demand
Q1 FY2026 beat on top and bottom line: EPS $0.26 vs $0.18 expected, revenue $380.4M vs $374.7M expected; raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint to $2.86 above $2.81 consensus; stock jumped ~10%

TD Cowen upgraded from Hold to Buy, raised price target to $120; cited improving same-store sales (+6% comp growth in Q2), margin recovery from labor investments and cost cuts, and operational improvements under CEO Brian Niccol; stock hit 52-week high

Morgan Stanley highlighted Ford's energy storage business and CATL battery relationship as underappreciated growth driver for Model e segment; stock rose ~7% adding to prior day's 13% surge; two-day rally of ~20% total

UBS raised price target to $275 from $245, maintained Buy rating, citing strong AI infrastructure demand ahead of upcoming earnings; stock tops $230 with analysts calling it still cheap; BofA also resets price target upward
Q2 FY2026 beat-and-raise reported after-hours; stock rose ~2% during regular session ahead of results then gained ~4.5% after-hours; shares up 73% YTD in 2026 on semiconductor equipment demand

Experimental Alzheimer's drug advances to Phase 3 trial despite missing Phase 2 primary endpoint; showed cognitive benefits in secondary measures; stock had volatile session, up ~4% early then reversed to -5% midday
Q1 2026 revenue rose sharply year-over-year; cruise line operator reported strong travel demand; stock moved higher on the earnings beat alongside StubHub as live-experience sector outperforms

Q4 and full fiscal year 2026 results reported pre-market; stock trading at $10.68, below all major moving averages amid earnings misses and declining profitability; one of Bloomberg's premarket mover features for the day

Trump-Xi Beijing summit: China agreed to order 200 Boeing jets per Trump announcement to Fox News; stock down ~3.8% to $231 as market had priced in higher expectations; trade deal optimism partially offset by order-size disappointment
BofA Securities raised price target to $612 from $510; semiconductor metrology equipment maker benefiting from AI chip manufacturing buildout demand
